title: The three site axioms for a class of indexed covering families
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category whose objects and arrows form sets. An indexed family with target $X$ consists of a set $I$, objects $U_i$ and arrows $f_i:U_i\to X$. A class $\operatorname{Cov}$ of such families satisfies the class covering axioms if it contains the standard singleton family of every isomorphism, contains the indexed composite of each of its families with a family in the class on each domain (indexed by $\coprod_i J_i$), and, for every family in the class and every arrow $Y\to X$, there exist fibre-product presentations on the same index set whose family of projections to $Y$ is in the class. These are the three axioms of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](1), without requiring the collection of families to be a set, and without adding a reindexing convention.
